stations.title: Wilma
stations.say: One site, with a record of changes?
stations.note: Four copies on the shop computer.

stations.title: Site copies
stations.text: Copied folders, each a bit different.
stations.note: Nobody knows which one is right.

captions: At Pennywhistle Books, Wilma wants one website with a record of every change.
Today the site lives in copies, and two of them open at different times on Saturdays.
You turn the folder into a repository and save it, then save the new hours, in four tasks.
The history holds the site as it was, then the new Saturday hours on top.
One folder, one answer, and every change written down.
